key_difference: (D) changes the public QMetaTypeIdQObject default argument and adds PointerToQObject/IsGadget specializations, so QMetaTypeId2::Defined changes for every user of the header, and its 'unique' tag is a named QtPrivate struct, not one in an anonymous namespace. (B) instead keeps the logic inside ConnectionTypes, applies MetatypeDecay, and passes an anonymous-namespace UniqueType through to is_complete, so the result cannot be folded across translation units where completeness differs.
